comment: The per-turn deliberate progress capability (ADR-0130), frozen across the three services it crosses, which ship in different images and share no module. The worker (apps/worker/src/curie_worker/turn_progress.py) durably allocates a monotonically increasing generation for the chain, marks that generation active, and mints a sandbox token with `token_scope` whose subject is `progress_id:generation`. It sends the capability URL (`route` under the API base), token, and generation to the runner on POST /v1/event in `url_header`, `token_header`, and `generation_header`. The runner (runner/src/curie_runner/turn_progress.py) reads those headers, holds them for the open turn only, and POSTs each progress command to the URL with the token in `token_request_header`; it adds the worker-issued generation and its own per-turn sequence. The API (apps/api/src/curie_api/turn_progress.py) verifies the token against that subject and scope, atomically refuses a generation that is no longer active, appends the command to the chain's inbox stream at `inbox_key`, and indexes the chain in `inbox_pending_key`. One entry per command has exactly the fields of `inbox_entry_example`; the live pump or maintenance drainer reads it. Read by apps/worker/tests/test_turn_progress_vector.py, runner/tests/test_turn_progress_vector.py and apps/api/tests/test_turn_progress_vector.py, each of which rejects an unknown key so a key added for one reader cannot pass vacuously.
